# qs/sell quipusoft-rules

The rules and ADRs of the qs/sell pilot. Contains:

- `adr/0001-batched-import.md` — lowercase adr (P4: case-insensitive matching)
- `ADR/0002-entity-flow.md` — uppercase ADR (P4: case-insensitive matching)
- `rule/import-rules.md` — import rules

The pilot searches `adr/` and `ADR/` for the knowledge intent.
